high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from The Times of India, dated two days ago. The headline reads, "Watch: Robot walks into Rolex store in New York, leaves people stunned." The article appears to be an opinion piece. The main focus of the image is on two robots standing outside a Rolex store in New York. The robot on the left is smaller and has a more humanoid appearance with a black head and white body. It is positioned as if it is looking at the larger robot on the right.
